VibePascal v54 Linux x86_64 compiler -- NativeInt + default-string-type
inference for inline vars (God directive mtkt2shb)
Source commit: b7d2d9676ecf1d7d8250cd460b9c48069920513e
Compiler fix:  b9cb8fea875670cfc48f7d83b88d4af39a28aa6e
Parent release: v53 (9e20efe4d6912fe6a9558c442ae4fa8d5dfe3045)
Built: 2026-09-03, native self-host on x86_64-linux
ppcx64 md5:    EB57AA4D7A3C1317CAF5921A6DDABF7B
ppcx64 sha256: (see LATEST.txt in this directory)

Contents: bin/ppcx64 only -- this is a COMPILER-BINARY refresh, meant to drop
into an existing VibePascal source/unit tree on Linux.  It carries no RTL or
package units: nothing in the RTL, the packages or the PPU format changed
between v53 and v54, so an existing v53 (or v52) Linux unit set stays valid.
The Linux utility binaries (ppudump/ppumove/fpcres/...) are likewise unchanged
and are not re-shipped; build them from the tree if you need them.

This is the exact binary every v54 verification result was produced with, and
it is the compiler that cross-built the v54 Win64 ppcx64.exe.

Change in this release: an untyped INTEGER initialiser for an inline var (and
for an inferred `for var i := ...` counter) now infers NativeInt instead of the
hard-coded LongInt -- 8 bytes on a 64-bit target, 4 on a 32-bit one -- and a
string/char literal initialiser now infers exactly what a bare `string` denotes
at that point.  Only types narrower than NativeInt are widened; explicit
typecasts are never promoted.  See dist/win64/staging-v54/VERSION.txt for the
full change and validation record.

Verified on this platform (x86_64-linux), against a baseline compiler built
from the parent commit (23618ea0680578c23f16059b58b71757):
- tinlinevarnativeint1.pp: 45 assertions, 13 structural contexts, baseline 26
  failures -> 0, under both -Munleashed and -Mdelphiunicode.
- tinlinevarstrinfer1.pp: 20 assertions over $H+/$H-, baseline 4 -> 0, both modes.
- full tests/test corpus, 2098 tests, with a nondeterminism control run:
  zero unintended regression.
- self-host fixpoint byte-identical (stage B == stage C).
The 32-bit half of the directive was verified separately with a v54 i386-linux
cross compiler: the same 45-assertion matrix reports NativeInt=4 and PASSes.
